map.由半径与转角求切线长: Tangent Length from Radius and Deflection Angle
map.输入圆曲线半径 R 与转角 Δ（度），求切线长。: Enter circular-curve radius R and deflection angle Δ (degrees) to obtain the tangent length.
map.📖 查看「由半径与转角求切线长 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Tangent Length from Radius and Deflection Angle User Guide"
map.切线长为曲线主点间距。: The tangent length is the spacing between curve main points.
map.由半径转角算切线长 T。: Compute tangent length T from radius and deflection angle.
map.从交点量 T 定直圆点。: Measure T from the intersection to set the tangent-to-curve point.
map.R=200m、Δ=60° → T=R·tan(Δ/2)=200×tan30°≈1: R=200 m, Δ=60° → T = R·tan(Δ/2) = 200×tan30° ≈ 115.5 m; measure T along each tangent from JD to get ZY/YZ.
map.T 是曲线放样起点基准，配合 L 定全线桩号。: T is the baseline start of curve staking, with L setting the whole alignment's stations.
map.切线长公式？: What is the tangent length formula?
map.T=R·tan(Δ/2)，Δ 为转角（曲线圆心角）。: T = R·tan(Δ/2), Δ is the deflection angle (curve central angle).
map.T 和 E 关系？: What is the relation between T and E?
map.T 沿切线、E 沿分角线，E=T·tan(Δ/4) 近似，几何不同方向。: T runs along the tangent, E along the bisector; E = T·tan(Δ/4) approximately, different geometric directions.
